aviation_incidents.headline: 葉門青年運動攻擊沙烏地哈立德國王國際機場 1名臺籍民眾受傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 外交部表示，葉門青年運動攻擊沙烏地哈立德國王國際機場，造成1名臺籍民眾受傷。駐沙烏地代表處已派員赴醫院探視並提供協助，將持續掌握當地臺灣民眾情形。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport injures one Taiwanese national
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Taiwan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport injured one Taiwanese national. Taiwan’s representative office in Saudi Arabia sent staff to visit the person at the hospital and provide assistance, and will continue monitoring the situation of Taiwanese nationals in the country.
entities: 駐沙烏地阿拉伯代表處

sources.name: 中央社 CNA — 沙烏地機場遇襲 外交部：1台籍民眾受傷已提供協助

aviation_incidents.headline: 達美航空234號班機在本古裏安機場受檢 未發現可信威脅
aviation_incidents.summary: 達美航空234號班機降落本古裏安機場後，乘客下機並由當地主管機關檢查。達美航空表示，檢查未發現可信威脅，乘客與機組員均安全送往航廈；機場方面表示運作已恢復正常。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Delta Flight 234 inspected at Ben Gurion Airport, with no credible threat found
aviation_incidents.summary_en: After Delta Flight 234 landed at Ben Gurion Airport, passengers deplaned and local authorities inspected the aircraft. Delta said no credible threat was found and that passengers and crew were safely taken to the terminal. The airport authority said operations had returned to normal.

aviation_incidents.headline: 澳洲航空因旅客反映遭牀蝨叮咬取消羅馬飛伯斯QF6 波音787深層清潔
aviation_incidents.summary: 10月9日QF5航班旅客反映在經濟艙遭昆蟲叮咬後，澳洲航空取消原定10月10日由羅馬飛往伯斯的QF6。航空公司表示，取消是為讓工程與維修團隊深層清潔該架波音787；旅客獲安排住宿，並在原定出發時間48小時內改簽。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Qantas cancels Rome–Perth QF6 after bedbug bites were reported on QF5, grounds Boeing 787 for deep clean
aviation_incidents.summary_en: After passengers on Qantas QF5 on 9 October reported insect bites in the economy cabin, the airline cancelled QF6 from Rome to Perth, scheduled for 10 October. Qantas said the cancellation allowed engineering and maintenance teams to deep-clean the Boeing 787. Passengers received accommodation and were rebooked within 48 hours of their original departure time.

aviation_incidents.headline: Corendon Airlines客機疑似空中緊急狀況 德國空軍戰機護送安全降落紐倫堡
aviation_incidents.summary: 2026年10月13日，紐倫堡機場接獲一架自希臘科孚島抵達的Corendon Airlines客機可能發生空中緊急狀況的通報，暫停航班作業。德國空軍Eurofighter戰機護送客機降落，客機安全著陸；警方表示，疑似空中緊急狀況尚未確認，正調查原因。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: German Air Force jets escort Corendon Airlines aircraft to safe landing in Nuremberg amid unconfirmed emergency report
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On 13 October 2026, Nuremberg Airport suspended flight operations after receiving a report of a possible in-flight emergency aboard a Corendon Airlines aircraft arriving from Corfu, Greece. German Air Force Eurofighters escorted the aircraft, which landed safely. Police said the suspected emergency had not been confirmed and that they were investigating the cause.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 愛沙尼亞國防部長稱可考慮採購輕型噴射機攔截俄羅斯攻擊無人機
taiwan_aviation.summary: 愛沙尼亞國防部長Martin Herem在2026年10月11日刊出的訪問中表示，愛沙尼亞應考慮採購輕型噴射機，攔截俄羅斯噴射動力遠程攻擊無人機。他說渦輪螺旋槳飛機可能不足，並稱愛沙尼亞或許應採購輕型戰鬥機。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Estonian defence minister says country could consider light jets to intercept Russian attack drones
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: In an interview published on 11 October 2026, Estonian Defence Minister Martin Herem said Estonia should consider acquiring light jets to intercept Russian jet-powered long-range attack drones. He said turboprop aircraft might not be enough and that Estonia might need light jets, possibly including light fighter aircraft.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士公布10月5日至9日股票回購交易 用於員工持股及股權薪酬計畫
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士於10月12日公布10月5日至9日的股票回購交易，表示交易屬於公司9月11日宣布的回購計畫，目的是支援未來員工持股及股權薪酬計畫。該計畫依股東於2026年4月14日授予董事會的權限執行，回購上限為已發行股本的10%。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus reports share buybacks from 5 to 9 October for employee ownership and equity compensation plans
international_aviation.summary_en: On 12 October, Airbus reported share buyback transactions carried out from 5 to 9 October as part of a programme announced on 11 September. The company said the programme is intended to support future employee share ownership and equity-based compensation plans. It is conducted under shareholder authority granted on 14 April 2026, allowing repurchases of up to 10% of issued share capital.

sources.name: Airbus — Airbus reports share buyback transactions 05-09 October 2026

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空將亞特蘭大—利雅德航線啟航延至2027年3月
international_aviation.summary: 達美航空於2026年10月12日宣布，將原定10月23日啟航的亞特蘭大—利雅德航線延至2027年3月。該航線原規劃成為達美航空首條直飛沙烏地阿拉伯的客運服務；達美表示正與政府及航空業夥伴保持聯繫並監看事態發展。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta postpones Atlanta–Riyadh route launch until March 2027
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta announced on 12 October 2026 that it had postponed the Atlanta–Riyadh route launch, originally scheduled for 23 October, until March 2027. The route was planned to be Delta’s first direct passenger service to Saudi Arabia. The airline said it remained in contact with government and aviation partners and was monitoring developments.

international_aviation.headline: Joby要求法院推翻Aerosonic近1.17億美元陪審團裁決 案件尚未作成最終判決
international_aviation.summary: Joby Aviation已請求聯邦法院推翻陪審團判給Aerosonic近1.17億美元的裁決。陪審團於2026年10月2日在佛羅裏達州坦帕認定Joby違反保密協議並侵佔商業機密，但裁決尚非最終判決。Joby稱其自行開發飛機感測器，並將繼續提出法律挑戰。
international_aviation.headline_en: Joby asks court to overturn nearly $117 million Aerosonic jury award; verdict is not final
international_aviation.summary_en: Joby Aviation has asked a federal court to overturn a nearly $117 million jury award to Aerosonic. On 2 October 2026, a jury in Tampa, Florida, found that Joby breached a confidentiality agreement and misappropriated trade secrets, but the verdict is not yet a final judgment. Joby says it developed its aircraft sensors independently and will pursue further legal challenges.

sources.name: AeroTime — Joby seeks to overturn $117 million trade secrets verdict

international_aviation.headline: Sikorsky推出Nomad 100 Fast Pack 可用單一貨櫃部署四架自主飛行器
international_aviation.summary: Sikorsky於2026年10月12日公布Nomad 100 Fast Pack，將四架自主飛行器及操作設備裝入一個20英尺貨櫃，供軍方從船隻、車輛集結區及偏遠地點部署，無需跑道或大量地面支援。規劃配置可在15分鐘內備妥兩架飛行器，另兩架可於四至六小時內準備完成。
international_aviation.headline_en: Sikorsky unveils Nomad 100 Fast Pack to deploy four autonomous aircraft from one container
international_aviation.summary_en: Sikorsky announced the Nomad 100 Fast Pack on 12 October 2026, fitting four autonomous aircraft and operating equipment in one 20-foot container. It is designed for military crews to deploy aircraft from ships, vehicle staging areas and remote sites without a runway or extensive ground support. In the planned configuration, two aircraft can be prepared in under 15 minutes, with the other two ready within four to six hours.

international_aviation.headline: 美國聯邦航空總署要求拆除15具A380高壓渦輪級間封嚴
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署要求空中巴士A380進行發動機更換作業，命令拆除15具高壓渦輪級間封嚴，並設有緊迫期限。報導摘要稱，每具發動機相關費用達六位數；標題表示，命令是在非包容性失效導致中止起飛後發布。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA orders removal of 15 high-pressure turbine interstage seals on Airbus A380 engines
international_aviation.summary_en: The FAA has ordered engine replacement work on Airbus A380s, including removal of 15 high-pressure turbine interstage seals under tight deadlines. The report’s summary says the cost per engine reaches six figures; its headline says the order followed an uncontained failure that forced an aborted takeoff.

international_aviation.headline: NASA據報接觸前SR-71工程人員探討NASA 844重返飛行 目前未獲公開確認
international_aviation.summary: NASA據報已接觸多名前SR-71工程人員，詢問能否協助讓NASA 844重返飛行；該機最後一次飛行是在1999年10月9日。NASA據報已將飛機移入愛德華茲空軍基地一座曾供太空梭使用的機庫，但尚未公開確認重返飛行計畫，也未說明用途。
international_aviation.headline_en: NASA reportedly contacts former SR-71 engineers about returning NASA 844 to flight; no plan publicly confirmed
international_aviation.summary_en: NASA has reportedly approached former SR-71 engineers about helping return NASA 844 to flight; the aircraft last flew on 9 October 1999. NASA has reportedly moved it into a hangar at Edwards Air Force Base formerly used for the Space Shuttle, but has not publicly confirmed a return-to-flight programme or explained how it would use the aircraft.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — Why no aircraft has ever replaced the SR-71 Blackbird News
